services.name: Meet your Fishing Guides
services.desc: Pacific Salmon cruise the shorline and estuaries surrounding the Campbell River area from mid August to mid October, before they begin to enter their native rivers along the coast. While cruising, these salmon are voraciously feeding. This provides excellent opportunity to hook one of these aggressive fish on a fly. Whether from shore, in one of our pontoon boats or from our anchored boat, our Campbell River salmon fly fishing guides will get you to where the salmon are. guided fly fishing trips campbell river, spinner fishing, float fishing and more!
